_about: Items present in BOTH the PDI Item Sales exports and the XO Liquor Boulder item list, as written by scripts/match_pdi_items.py (pdi-matched.csv: UPC = PDI item code + check digit, Description = PDI wording, Units = the list's stated units per case, 1 included).
